name: NewVersion
meaning: Computes the next version number from a "major.minor.patch" text: type "major" increments major and sets minor and patch to 0; "minor" keeps major, increments minor and sets patch to 0; "patch" keeps major and minor and increments patch; any other type keeps all three except patch, which becomes 0.
